38.text: And Jesus having turned, and having beheld them following, saith to them, 'What seek ye?' and they said to them, 'Rabbi, (which is, being interpreted, Teacher,) where remainest thou?'

39.text: He saith to them, 'Come and see;' they came, and saw where he doth remain, and with him they remained that day and the hour was about the tenth.

42.text: and he brought him unto Jesus: and having looked upon him, Jesus saith, 'Thou art Simon, the son of Jonas, thou shalt be called Cephas,' (which is interpreted, A rock.)

47.text: Jesus saw Nathanael coming unto him, and he saith concerning him, 'Lo, truly an Israelite, in whom guile is not;'

50.text: Jesus answered and said to him, 'Because I said to thee, I saw thee under the fig-tree, thou dost believe; greater things than these thou shalt see;'

3.text: Jesus answered and said to him, 'Verily, verily, I say to thee, If any one may not be born from above, he is not able to see the reign of God;'

7.text: 'Thou mayest not wonder that I said to thee, It behoveth you to be born from above;

10.text: Jesus answered and said to him, 'Thou art the teacher of Israel — and these things thou dost not know!

11.text: 'Verily, verily, I say to thee — What we have known we speak, and what we have seen we testify, and our testimony ye do not receive;

12.text: if the earthly things I said to you, and ye do not believe, how, if I shall say to you the heavenly things, will ye believe?

13.text: and no one hath gone up to the heaven, except he who out of the heaven came down — the Son of Man who is in the heaven.

14.text: 'And as Moses did lift up the serpent in the wilderness, so it behoveth the Son of Man to be lifted up,

15.text: that every one who is believing in him may not perish, but may have life age-during,

16.text: for God did so love the world, that His Son — the only begotten — He gave, that every one who is believing in him may not perish, but may have life age-during.

17.text: For God did not send His Son to the world that he may judge the world, but that the world may be saved through him;

18.text: he who is believing in him is not judged, but he who is not believing hath been judged already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.

19.text: 'And this is the judgment, that the light hath come to the world, and men did love the darkness rather than the light, for their works were evil;

20.text: for every one who is doing wicked things hateth the light, and doth not come unto the light, that his works may not be detected;

21.text: but he who is doing the truth doth come to the light, that his works may be manifested, that in God they are having been wrought.'

7.text: there cometh a woman out of Samaria to draw water. Jesus saith to her, 'Give me to drink;'

10.text: Jesus answered and said to her, 'If thou hadst known the gift of God, and who it is who is saying to thee, Give me to drink, thou wouldest have asked him, and he would have given thee living water.'

13.text: Jesus answered and said to her, 'Every one who is drinking of this water shall thirst again;

14.text: but whoever may drink of the water that I will give him, may not thirst — to the age; and the water that I will give him shall become in him a well of water, springing up to life age-during.'

16.text: Jesus saith to her, 'Go, call thy husband, and come hither;'

17.text: the woman answered and said, 'I have not a husband.' Jesus saith to her, 'Well didst thou say — A husband I have not;

18.text: for five husbands thou hast had, and, now, he whom thou hast is not thy husband; this hast thou said truly.'

21.text: Jesus saith to her, 'Woman, believe me, that there doth come an hour, when neither in this mountain, nor in Jerusalem, shall ye worship the Father;

22.text: ye worship what ye have not known; we worship what we have known, because the salvation is of the Jews;

23.text: but, there cometh an hour, and it now is, when the true worshippers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father also doth seek such to worship him;

24.text: God [is] a Spirit, and those worshipping Him, in spirit and truth it doth behove to worship.'

26.text: Jesus saith to her, 'I am [he], who am speaking to thee.'

32.text: and he said to them, 'I have food to eat that ye have not known.'

34.text: Jesus saith to them, 'My food is, that I may do the will of Him who sent me, and may finish His work;

35.text: do not say that it is yet four months, and the harvest cometh; lo, I say to you, Lift up your eyes, and see the fields, that they are white unto harvest already.

36.text: 'And he who is reaping doth receive a reward, and doth gather fruit to life age-during, that both he who is sowing and he who is reaping may rejoice together;

37.text: for in this the saying is the true one, that one is the sower and another the reaper.

38.text: I sent you to reap that on which ye have not laboured; others laboured, and ye into their labour have entered.

48.text: Jesus then said unto him, 'If signs and wonders ye may not see, ye will not believe.'

50.text: Jesus saith to him, 'Be going on; thy son doth live.' And the man believed the word that Jesus said to him, and was going on,

53.text: then the father knew that [it was] in that hour in which Jesus said to him — 'Thy son doth live,' and he himself believed, and his whole house;

6.text: him Jesus having seen lying, and having known that he is already a long time, he saith to him, 'Dost thou wish to become whole?'

8.text: Jesus saith to him, 'Rise, take up thy couch, and be walking;'

14.text: After these things, Jesus findeth him in the temple, and said to him, 'Lo, thou hast become whole; sin no more, lest something worse may happen to thee.'

17.text: And Jesus answered them, 'My Father till now doth work, and I work;'

19.text: Jesus therefore responded and said to them, 'Verily, verily, I say to you, The Son is not able to do anything of himself, if he may not see the Father doing anything; for whatever things He may do, these also the Son in like manner doth;

20.text: for the Father doth love the Son, and doth shew to him all things that He himself doth; and greater works than these He will shew him, that ye may wonder.

21.text: 'For, as the Father doth raise the dead, and doth make alive, so also the Son doth make alive whom he willeth;

22.text: for neither doth the Father judge any one, but all the judgment He hath given to the Son,

23.text: that all may honour the Son according as they honour the Father; he who is not honouring the Son, doth not honour the Father who sent him.

24.text: 'Verily, verily, I say to you — He who is hearing my word, and is believing Him who sent me, hath life age-during, and to judgment he doth not come, but hath passed out of the death to the life.

25.text: 'Verily, verily, I say to you — There cometh an hour, and it now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God, and those having heard shall live;

26.text: for, as the Father hath life in himself, so He gave also to the Son to have life in himself,

27.text: and authority He gave him also to do judgment, because he is Son of Man.

28.text: 'Wonder not at this, because there doth come an hour in which all those in the tombs shall hear his voice,

29.text: and they shall come forth; those who did the good things to a rising again of life, and those who practised the evil things to a rising again of judgment.

30.text: 'I am not able of myself to do anything; according as I hear I judge, and my judgment is righteous, because I seek not my own will, but the will of the Father who sent me.

31.text: 'If I testify concerning myself, my testimony is not true;

32.text: another there is who is testifying concerning me, and I have known that the testimony that he doth testify concerning me is true;

33.text: ye have sent unto John, and he hath testified to the truth.

34.text: 'But I do not receive testimony from man, but these things I say that ye may be saved;

35.text: he was the burning and shining lamp, and ye did will to be glad, for an hour, in his light.

36.text: 'But I have the testimony greater than John's, for the works that the Father gave me, that I might finish them, the works themselves that I do, they testify concerning me, that the Father hath sent me.

37.text: 'And the Father who sent me Himself hath testified concerning me; ye have neither heard His voice at any time, nor His appearance have ye seen;

38.text: and His word ye have not remaining in you, because whom He sent, him ye do not believe.

39.text: 'Ye search the Writings, because ye think in them to have life age-during, and these are they that are testifying concerning me;

40.text: and ye do not will to come unto me, that ye may have life;

41.text: glory from man I do not receive,

42.text: but I have known you, that the love of God ye have not in yourselves.

43.text: 'I have come in the name of my Father, and ye do not receive me; if another may come in his own name, him ye will receive;

44.text: how are ye able — ye — to believe, glory from one another receiving, and the glory that [is] from God alone ye seek not?

45.text: 'Do not think that I will accuse you unto the Father; there is who is accusing you, Moses — in whom ye have hoped;

46.text: for if ye were believing Moses, ye would have been believing me, for he wrote concerning me;

47.text: but if his writings ye believe not, how shall ye believe my sayings?'

5.text: Jesus then having lifted up [his] eyes and having seen that a great multitude doth come to him, saith unto Philip, 'Whence shall we buy loaves, that these may eat?' —

10.text: And Jesus said, 'Make the men to sit down;' and there was much grass in the place, the men then sat down, in number, as it were, five thousand,

12.text: And when they were filled, he saith to his disciples, 'Gather together the broken pieces that are over, that nothing may be lost;'

20.text: and he saith to them, 'I am [he], be not afraid;'

26.text: Jesus answered them and said, 'Verily, verily, I say to you, Ye seek me, not because ye saw signs, but because ye did eat of the loaves, and were satisfied;

27.text: work not for the food that is perishing, but for the food that is remaining to life age-during, which the Son of Man will give to you, for him did the Father seal — [even] God.'

29.text: Jesus answered and said to them, 'This is the work of God, that ye may believe in him whom He did send.'

32.text: Jesus, therefore, said to them, 'Verily, verily, I say to you, Moses did not give you the bread out of the heaven; but my Father doth give you the true bread out of the heaven;

33.text: for the bread of God is that which is coming down out of the heaven, and giving life to the world.'

35.text: And Jesus said to them, 'I am the bread of the life; he who is coming unto me may not hunger, and he who is believing in me may not thirst — at any time;

36.text: but I said to you, that ye also have seen me, and ye believe not;

37.text: all that the Father doth give to me will come unto me; and him who is coming unto me, I may in no wise cast without,

38.text: because I have come down out of the heaven, not that I may do my will, but the will of Him who sent me.

39.text: 'And this is the will of the Father who sent me, that all that He hath given to me I may not lose of it, but may raise it up in the last day;

40.text: and this is the will of Him who sent me, that every one who is beholding the Son, and is believing in him, may have life age-during, and I will raise him up in the last day.'

43.text: Jesus answered, therefore, and said to them, 'Murmur not one with another;

44.text: no one is able to come unto me, if the Father who sent me may not draw him, and I will raise him up in the last day;

45.text: it is having been written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of God; every one therefore who heard from the Father, and learned, cometh to me;

46.text: not that any one hath seen the Father, except he who is from God, he hath seen the Father.

47.text: 'Verily, verily, I say to you, He who is believing in me, hath life age-during;

48.text: I am the bread of the life;

49.text: your fathers did eat the manna in the wilderness, and they died;

50.text: this is the bread that out of the heaven is coming down, that any one may eat of it, and not die.

51.text: 'I am the living bread that came down out of the heaven; if any one may eat of this bread he shall live — to the age; and the bread also that I will give is my flesh, that I will give for the life of the world.'

53.text: Jesus, therefore, said to them, 'Verily, verily, I say to you, If ye may not eat the flesh of the Son of Man, and may not drink his blood, ye have no life in yourselves;

54.text: he who is eating my flesh, and is drinking my blood, hath life age-during, and I will raise him up in the last day;

55.text: for my flesh truly is food, and my blood truly is drink;

56.text: he who is eating my flesh, and is drinking my blood, doth remain in me, and I in him.

57.text: 'According as the living Father sent me, and I live because of the Father, he also who is eating me, even that one shall live because of me;

58.text: this is the bread that came down out of the heaven; not as your fathers did eat the manna, and died; he who is eating this bread shall live — to the age.'

61.text: And Jesus having known in himself that his disciples are murmuring about this, said to them, 'Doth this stumble you?

62.text: if then ye may behold the Son of Man going up where he was before?

63.text: the spirit it is that is giving life; the flesh doth not profit anything; the sayings that I speak to you are spirit, and they are life;

64.text: but there are certain of you who do not believe;' for Jesus had known from the beginning who they are who are not believing, and who is he who will deliver him up,

65.text: and he said, 'Because of this I have said to you — No one is able to come unto me, if it may not have been given him from my Father.'

67.text: Jesus, therefore, said to the twelve, 'Do ye also wish to go away?'

70.text: Jesus answered them, 'Did not I choose you — the twelve? and of you — one is a devil.

6.text: Jesus, therefore, saith to them, 'My time is not yet present, but your time is always ready;

7.text: the world is not able to hate you, but me it doth hate, because I testify concerning it that its works are evil.

8.text: Ye — go ye up to this feast; I do not yet go up to this feast, because my time hath not yet been fulfilled;'

16.text: Jesus answered them and said, 'My teaching is not mine, but His who sent me;

17.text: if any one may will to do His will, he shall know concerning the teaching, whether it is of God, or — I do speak from myself.

18.text: 'He who is speaking from himself his own glory doth seek, but he who is seeking the glory of him who sent him, this one is true, and unrighteousness is not in him;

19.text: hath not Moses given you the law? and none of you doth the law; why me do ye seek to kill?'

21.text: Jesus answered and said to them, 'One work I did, and ye all wonder,

22.text: because of this, Moses hath given you the circumcision — not that it is of Moses, but of the fathers — and on a sabbath ye circumcise a man;

23.text: if a man doth receive circumcision on a sabbath that the law of Moses may not be broken, are ye wroth with me that I made a man all whole on a sabbath?

24.text: judge not according to appearance, but the righteous judgment judge.'

28.text: Jesus cried, therefore, in the temple, teaching and saying, 'Ye have both known me, and ye have known whence I am; and I have not come of myself, but He who sent me is true, whom ye have not known;

29.text: and I have known Him, because I am from Him, and He did send me.'

33.text: Jesus, therefore, said to them, 'Yet a little time I am with you, and I go away unto Him who sent me;

34.text: ye will seek me, and ye shall not find; and where I am, ye are not able to come.'

37.text: And in the last, the great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, 'If any one doth thirst, let him come unto me and drink;

7.text: and when they continued asking him, having bent himself back, he said unto them, 'The sinless of you — let him first cast the stone at her;'

10.text: And Jesus having bent himself back, and having seen no one but the woman, said to her, 'Woman, where are those — thine accusers? did no one pass sentence upon thee?'

11.text: and she said, 'No one, Sir;' and Jesus said to her, 'Neither do I pass sentence on thee; be going on, and no more sin.'

12.text: Again, therefore, Jesus spake to them, saying, 'I am the light of the world; he who is following me shall not walk in the darkness, but he shall have the light of the life.'

14.text: Jesus answered and said to them, 'And if I testify of myself — my testimony is true, because I have known whence I came, and whither I go, and ye — ye have not known whence I come, or whither I go.

15.text: 'Ye according to the flesh do judge; I do not judge any one,

16.text: and even if I do judge my judgment is true, because I am not alone, but I and the Father who sent me;

17.text: and also in your law it hath been written, that the testimony of two men are true;

18.text: I am [one] who is testifying of myself, and the Father who sent me doth testify of me.'

19.text: They said, therefore, to him, 'Where is thy father?' Jesus answered, 'Ye have neither known me nor my Father: if me ye had known, my Father also ye had known.'

21.text: therefore said Jesus again to them, 'I go away, and ye will seek me, and in your sin ye shall die; whither I go away, ye are not able to come.'

23.text: and he said to them, 'Ye are from beneath, I am from above; ye are of this world, I am not of this world;

24.text: I said, therefore, to you, that ye shall die in your sins, for if ye may not believe that I am [he], ye shall die in your sins.'

25.text: They said, therefore, to him, 'Thou — who art thou?' and Jesus said to them, 'Even what I did speak of to you at the beginning;

26.text: many things I have to speak concerning you and to judge, but He who sent me is true, and I — what things I heard from Him — these I say to the world.'

28.text: Jesus, therefore, said to them, 'When ye may lift up the Son of Man then ye will know that I am [he]; and of myself I do nothing, but according as my Father did teach me, these things I speak;

29.text: and He who sent me is with me; the Father did not leave me alone, because I, the things pleasing to Him, do always.'

31.text: Jesus, therefore, said unto the Jews who believed in him, 'If ye may remain in my word, truly my disciples ye are, and ye shall know the truth,

32.text: and the truth shall make you free.'

34.text: Jesus answered them, 'Verily, verily, I say to you — Every one who is committing sin, is a servant of the sin,

35.text: and the servant doth not remain in the house — to the age, the son doth remain — to the age;

36.text: if then the son may make you free, in reality ye shall be free.

37.text: 'I have known that ye are seed of Abraham, but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you;

38.text: I — that which I have seen with my Father do speak, and ye, therefore, that which ye have seen with your father — ye do.'

39.text: They answered and said to him, 'Our father is Abraham;' Jesus saith to them, 'If children of Abraham ye were, the works of Abraham ye were doing;

40.text: and now, ye seek to kill me — a man who hath spoken to you the truth I heard from God; this Abraham did not;

41.text: ye do the works of your father.' They said, therefore, to him, 'We of whoredom have not been born; one Father we have — God;'

42.text: Jesus then said to them, 'If God were your father, ye were loving me, for I came forth from God, and am come; for neither have I come of myself, but He sent me;

43.text: wherefore do ye not know my speech? because ye are not able to hear my word.

44.text: 'Ye are of a father — the devil, and the desires of your father ye will to do; he was a man-slayer from the beginning, and in the truth he hath not stood, because there is no truth in him; when one may speak the falsehood, of his own he speaketh, because he is a liar — also his father.

45.text: 'And because I say the truth, ye do not believe me.

46.text: Who of you doth convict me of sin? and if I speak truth, wherefore do ye not believe me?

47.text: he who is of God, the sayings of God he doth hear; because of this ye do not hear, because of God ye are not.'

49.text: Jesus answered, 'I have not a demon, but I honour my Father, and ye dishonour me;

50.text: and I do not seek my own glory; there is who is seeking and is judging;

51.text: verily, verily, I say to you, If any one may keep my word, death he may not see — to the age.'

54.text: Jesus answered, 'If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing; it is my Father who is glorifying me, of whom ye say that He is your God;

55.text: and ye have not known Him, and I have known Him, and if I say that I have not known Him, I shall be like you — speaking falsely; but I have known Him, and His word I keep;

56.text: Abraham, your father, was glad that he might see my day; and he saw, and did rejoice.'

58.text: Jesus said to them, 'Verily, verily, I say to you, Before Abraham's coming — I am;'

3.text: Jesus answered, 'Neither did this one sin nor his parents, but that the works of God may be manifested in him;

4.text: it behoveth me to be working the works of Him who sent me while it is day; night doth come, when no one is able to work: —

5.text: when I am in the world, I am a light of the world.'

7.text: 'Go away, wash at the pool of Siloam,' which is, interpreted, Sent. He went away, therefore, and did wash, and came seeing;

35.text: Jesus heard that they cast him forth without, and having found him, he said to him, 'Dost thou believe in the Son of God?'

37.text: And Jesus said to him, 'Thou hast both seen him, and he who is speaking with thee is he;'

39.text: And Jesus said, 'For judgment I to this world did come, that those not seeing may see, and those seeing may become blind.'

41.text: Jesus said to them, 'If ye were blind, ye were not having had sin, but now ye say — We see, therefore doth your sin remain.

1.text: 'Verily, verily, I say to you, He who is not entering through the door to the fold of the sheep, but is going up from another side, that one is a thief and a robber;

2.text: and he who is entering through the door is shepherd of the sheep;

3.text: to this one the doorkeeper doth open, and the sheep hear his voice, and his own sheep he doth call by name, and doth lead them forth;

4.text: and when his own sheep he may put forth, before them he goeth on, and the sheep follow him, because they have known his voice;

5.text: and a stranger they will not follow, but will flee from him, because they have not known the voice of strangers.'

7.text: Jesus said therefore again to them, 'Verily, verily, I say to you — I am the door of the sheep;

8.text: all, as many as came before me, are thieves and robbers, but the sheep did not hear them;

9.text: I am the door, through me if any one may come in, he shall be saved, and he shall come in, and go out, and find pasture.

10.text: 'The thief doth not come, except that he may steal, and kill, and destroy; I came that they may have life, and may have [it] abundantly.

11.text: 'I am the good shepherd; the good shepherd his life layeth down for the sheep;

12.text: and the hireling, and not being a shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, doth behold the wolf coming, and doth leave the sheep, and doth flee; and the wolf catcheth them, and scattereth the sheep;

13.text: and the hireling doth flee because he is an hireling, and is not caring for the sheep.

14.text: 'I am the good shepherd, and I know my [sheep], and am known by mine,

15.text: according as the Father doth know me, and I know the Father, and my life I lay down for the sheep,

16.text: and other sheep I have that are not of this fold, these also it behoveth me to bring, and my voice they will hear, and there shall become one flock — one shepherd.

17.text: 'Because of this doth the Father love me, because I lay down my life, that again I may take it;

18.text: no one doth take it from me, but I lay it down of myself; authority I have to lay it down, and authority I have again to take it; this command I received from my Father.'

25.text: Jesus answered them, 'I told you, and ye do not believe; the works that I do in the name of my Father, these testify concerning me;

26.text: but ye do not believe, for ye are not of my sheep,

27.text: according as I said to you: My sheep my voice do hear, and I know them, and they follow me,

28.text: and life age-during I give to them, and they shall not perish — to the age, and no one shall pluck them out of my hand;

29.text: my Father, who hath given to me, is greater than all, and no one is able to pluck out of the hand of my Father;

30.text: I and the Father are one.'

32.text: Jesus answered them, 'Many good works did I shew you from my Father; because of which work of them do ye stone me?'

34.text: Jesus answered them, 'Is it not having been written in your law: I said, ye are gods?

35.text: if them he did call gods unto whom the word of God came, (and the Writing is not able to be broken,)

36.text: of him whom the Father did sanctify, and send to the world, do ye say — Thou speakest evil, because I said, Son of God I am?

37.text: if I do not the works of my Father, do not believe me;

38.text: and if I do, even if me ye may not believe, the works believe, that ye may know and may believe that in me [is] the Father, and I in Him.'

4.text: and Jesus having heard, said, 'This ailment is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God may be glorified through it.'

7.text: then after this, he saith to the disciples, 'We may go to Judea again;'

9.text: Jesus answered, 'Are there not twelve hours in the day? if any one may walk in the day, he doth not stumble, because the light of this world he doth see;

10.text: and if any one may walk in the night, he stumbleth, because the light is not in him.'

11.text: These things he said, and after this he saith to them, 'Lazarus our friend hath fallen asleep, but I go on that I may awake him;'

23.text: Jesus saith to her, 'Thy brother shall rise again.'

25.text: Jesus said to her, 'I am the rising again, and the life; he who is believing in me, even if he may die, shall live;

26.text: and every one who is living and believing in me shall not die — to the age;

34.text: 'Where have ye laid him?' they say to him, 'Sir, come and see;'

39.text: Jesus saith, 'Take ye away the stone;' the sister of him who hath died — Martha — saith to him, 'Sir, already he stinketh, for he is four days dead;'

40.text: Jesus saith to her, 'Said I not to thee, that if thou mayest believe, thou shalt see the glory of God?'

41.text: They took away, therefore, the stone where the dead was laid, and Jesus lifted his eyes upwards, and said, 'Father, I thank Thee, that Thou didst hear me;

42.text: and I knew that Thou always dost hear me, but, because of the multitude that is standing by, I said [it], that they may believe that Thou didst send me.'

43.text: And these things saying, with a loud voice he cried out, 'Lazarus, come forth;'

44.text: and he who died came forth, being bound feet and hands with grave-clothes, and his visage with a napkin was bound about; Jesus saith to them, 'Loose him, and suffer to go.'

7.text: Jesus, therefore, said, 'Suffer her; for the day of my embalming she hath kept it,

8.text: for the poor ye have always with yourselves, and me ye have not always.'

23.text: And Jesus responded to them, saying, 'The hour hath come that the Son of Man may be glorified;

24.text: verily, verily, I say to you, if the grain of the wheat, having fallen to the earth, may not die, itself remaineth alone; and if it may die, it doth bear much fruit;

25.text: he who is loving his life shall lose it, and he who is hating his life in this world — to life age-during shall keep it;

26.text: if any one may minister to me, let him follow me, and where I am, there also my ministrant shall be; and if any one may minister to me — honour him will the Father.

27.text: 'Now hath my soul been troubled, and what? shall I say — Father, save me from this hour? — but because of this I came to this hour;

28.text: Father, glorify Thy name.' There came, therefore, a voice out of the heaven, 'I both glorified, and again I will glorify [it];'

30.text: Jesus answered and said, 'Not because of me hath this voice come, but because of you;

31.text: now is a judgment of this world, now shall the ruler of this world be cast forth;

32.text: and I, if I may be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto myself.'

35.text: Jesus, therefore, said to them, 'Yet a little time is the light with you; walk while ye have the light, that darkness may not overtake you; and he who is walking in the darkness hath not known where he goeth;

36.text: while ye have the light, believe in the light, that sons of light ye may become.' These things spake Jesus, and having gone away, he was hid from them,

44.text: And Jesus cried and said, 'He who is believing in me, doth not believe in me, but in Him who sent me;

45.text: and he who is beholding me, doth behold Him who sent me;

46.text: I a light to the world have come, that every one who is believing in me — in the darkness may not remain;

47.text: and if any one may hear my sayings, and not believe, I — I do not judge him, for I came not that I might judge the world, but that I might save the world.

48.text: 'He who is rejecting me, and not receiving my sayings, hath one who is judging him, the word that I spake, that will judge him in the last day,

49.text: because I spake not from myself, but the Father who sent me, He did give me a command, what I may say, and what I may speak,

50.text: and I have known that His command is life age-during; what, therefore, I speak, according as the Father hath said to me, so I speak.'

7.text: Jesus answered and said to him, 'That which I do thou hast not known now, but thou shalt know after these things;'

8.text: Peter saith to him, 'Thou mayest not wash my feet — to the age.' Jesus answered him, 'If I may not wash thee, thou hast no part with me;'

10.text: Jesus saith to him, 'He who hath been bathed hath no need save to wash his feet, but he is clean altogether; and ye are clean, but not all;'

11.text: for he knew him who is delivering him up; because of this he said, 'Ye are not all clean.'

12.text: When, therefore, he washed their feet, and took his garments, having reclined (at meat) again, he said to them, 'Do ye know what I have done to you?

13.text: ye call me, The Teacher and The Lord, and ye say well, for I am;

14.text: if then I did wash your feet — the Lord and the Teacher — ye also ought to wash one another's feet.

15.text: 'For an example I gave to you, that, according as I did to you, ye also may do;

16.text: verily, verily, I say to you, a servant is not greater than his lord, nor an apostle greater than he who sent him;

17.text: if these things ye have known, happy are ye, if ye may do them;

18.text: not concerning you all do I speak; I have known whom I chose for myself; but that the Writing may be fulfilled: He who is eating the bread with me, did lift up against me his heel.

19.text: 'From this time I tell you, before its coming to pass, that, when it may come to pass, ye may believe that I am [he];

20.text: verily, verily, I say to you, he who is receiving whomsoever I may send, doth receive me; and he who is receiving me, doth receive Him who sent me.'

21.text: These things having said, Jesus was troubled in the spirit, and did testify, and said, 'Verily, verily, I say to you, that one of you will deliver me up;'

26.text: Jesus answereth, 'That one it is to whom I, having dipped the morsel, shall give it;' and having dipped the morsel, he giveth [it] to Judas of Simon, Iscariot.

27.text: And after the morsel, then the Adversary entered into that one, Jesus, therefore, saith to him, 'What thou dost — do quickly;'

31.text: When, therefore, he went forth, Jesus saith, 'Now was the Son of Man glorified, and God was glorified in him;

32.text: if God was glorified in him, God also will glorify him in Himself; yea, immediately He will glorify him.

33.text: 'Little children, yet a little am I with you; ye will seek me, and, according as I said to the Jews — Whither I go away, ye are not able to come, to you also I do say [it] now.

34.text: 'A new commandment I give to you, that ye love one another; according as I did love you, that ye also love one another;

35.text: in this shall all know that ye are my disciples, if ye may have love one to another.'

36.text: Simon Peter saith to him, 'Sir, whither dost thou go away?' Jesus answered him, 'Whither I go away, thou art not able now to follow me, but afterward thou shalt follow me.'

38.text: Jesus answered him, 'Thy life for me thou wilt lay down! verily, verily, I say to thee, a cock will not crow till thou mayest deny me thrice.'

1.text: 'Let not your heart be troubled, believe in God, also in me believe;

2.text: in the house of my Father are many mansions; and if not, I would have told you; I go on to prepare a place for you;

3.text: and if I go on and prepare for you a place, again do I come, and will receive you unto myself, that where I am ye also may be;

4.text: and whither I go away ye have known, and the way ye have known.'

6.text: Jesus saith to him, 'I am the way, and the truth, and the life, no one doth come unto the Father, if not through me;

7.text: if ye had known me, my Father also ye would have known, and from this time ye have known Him, and have seen Him.'

9.text: Jesus saith to him, 'So long time am I with you, and thou hast not known me, Philip? he who hath seen me hath seen the Father; and how dost thou say, Shew to us the Father?

10.text: Believest thou not that I [am] in the Father, and the Father is in me? the sayings that I speak to you, from myself I speak not, and the Father who is abiding in me, Himself doth the works;

11.text: believe me, that I [am] in the Father, and the Father in me; and if not, because of the works themselves, believe me.

12.text: 'Verily, verily, I say to you, he who is believing in me, the works that I do — that one also shall do, and greater than these he shall do, because I go on to my Father;

13.text: and whatever ye may ask in my name, I will do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son;

14.text: if ye ask anything in my name I will do [it].

15.text: 'If ye love me, my commands keep,

16.text: and I will ask the Father, and another Comforter He will give to you, that he may remain with you — to the age;

17.text: the Spirit of truth, whom the world is not able to receive, because it doth not behold him, nor know him, and ye know him, because he doth remain with you, and shall be in you.

18.text: 'I will not leave you bereaved, I come unto you;

19.text: yet a little, and the world doth no more behold me, and ye behold me, because I live, and ye shall live;

20.text: in that day ye shall know that I [am] in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you;

21.text: he who is having my commands, and is keeping them, that one it is who is loving me, and he who is loving me shall be loved by my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.'

23.text: Jesus answered and said to him, 'If any one may love me, my word he will keep, and my Father will love him, and unto him we will come, and abode with him we will make;

24.text: he who is not loving me, my words doth not keep; and the word that ye hear is not mine, but the Father's who sent me.

25.text: 'These things I have spoken to you, remaining with you,

26.text: and the Comforter, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, he will teach you all things, and remind you of all things that I said to you.

27.text: 'Peace I leave to you; my peace I give to you, not according as the world doth give do I give to you; let not your heart be troubled, nor let it be afraid;

28.text: ye heard that I said to you — I go away, and I come unto you; if ye did love me, ye would have rejoiced that I said — I go on to the Father, because my Father is greater than I.

29.text: 'And now I have said [it] to you before it come to pass, that when it may come to pass, ye may believe;

30.text: I will no more talk much with you, for the ruler of this world doth come, and in me he hath nothing;

31.text: but that the world may know that I love the Father, and according as the Father gave me command so I do; arise, we may go hence.

1.text: 'I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman;

2.text: every branch in me not bearing fruit, He doth take it away, and every one bearing fruit, He doth cleanse by pruning it, that it may bear more fruit;

3.text: already ye are clean, because of the word that I have spoken to you;

4.text: remain in me, and I in you, as the branch is not able to bear fruit of itself, if it may not remain in the vine, so neither ye, if ye may not remain in me.

5.text: 'I am the vine, ye the branches; he who is remaining in me, and I in him, this one doth bear much fruit, because apart from me ye are not able to do anything;

6.text: if any one may not remain in me, he was cast forth without as the branch, and was withered, and they gather them, and cast to fire, and they are burned;

7.text: if ye may remain in me, and my sayings in you may remain, whatever ye may wish ye shall ask, and it shall be done to you.

8.text: 'In this was my Father glorified, that ye may bear much fruit, and ye shall become my disciples.

9.text: According as the Father did love me, I also loved you, remain in my love;

10.text: if my commandments ye may keep, ye shall remain in my love, according as I the commands of my Father have kept, and do remain in His love;

11.text: these things I have spoken to you, that my joy in you may remain, and your joy may be full.

12.text: 'This is my command, that ye love one another, according as I did love you;

13.text: greater love than this hath no one, that any one his life may lay down for his friends;

14.text: ye are my friends, if ye may do whatever I command you;

15.text: no more do I call you servants, because the servant hath not known what his lord doth, and you I have called friends, because all things that I heard from my Father, I did make known to you.

16.text: 'Ye did not choose out me, but I chose out you, and did appoint you, that ye might go away, and might bear fruit, and your fruit might remain, that whatever ye may ask of the Father in my name, He may give you.

17.text: 'These things I command you, that ye love one another;

18.text: if the world doth hate you, ye know that it hath hated me before you;

19.text: if of the world ye were, the world its own would have been loving, and because of the world ye are not — but I chose out of the world — because of this the world hateth you.

20.text: 'Remember the word that I said to you, A servant is not greater than his lord; if me they did persecute, you also they will persecute; if my word they did keep, yours also they will keep;

21.text: but all these things will they do to you, because of my name, because they have not known Him who sent me;

22.text: if I had not come and spoken to them, they were not having sin; but now pretext they have not for their sin.

23.text: 'He who is hating me, doth hate also my Father;

24.text: if I did not do among them the works that no other hath done, they were not having sin, and now they have both seen and hated both me and my Father;

25.text: but — that the word may be fulfilled that was written in their law — They hated me without a cause.

26.text: 'And when the Comforter may come, whom I will send to you from the Father — the Spirit of truth, who from the Father doth come forth, he will testify of me;

27.text: and ye also do testify, because from the beginning ye are with me.

1.text: 'These things I have spoken to you, that ye may not be stumbled,

2.text: out of the synagogues they will put you; but an hour doth come, that every one who hath killed you, may think to offer service unto God;

3.text: and these things they will do to you, because they did not know the Father, nor me.

4.text: 'But these things I have spoken to you, that when the hour may come, ye may remember them, that I said [them] to you, and these things to you from the beginning I did not say, because I was with you;

5.text: and now I go away to Him who sent me, and none of you doth ask me, Whither dost thou go?

6.text: but because these things I have said to you, the sorrow hath filled your heart.

7.text: 'But I tell you the truth; it is better for you that I go away, for if I may not go away, the Comforter will not come unto you, and if I go on, I will send Him unto you;

8.text: and having come, He will convict the world concerning sin, and concerning righteousness, and concerning judgment;

9.text: concerning sin indeed, because they do not believe in me;

10.text: and concerning righteousness, because unto my Father I go away, and no more do ye behold me;

11.text: and concerning judgment, because the ruler of this world hath been judged.

12.text: 'I have yet many things to say to you, but ye are not able to bear [them] now;

13.text: and when He may come — the Spirit of truth — He will guide you to all the truth, for He will not speak from Himself, but as many things as He will hear He will speak, and the coming things He will tell you;

14.text: He will glorify me, because of mine He will take, and will tell to you.

15.text: 'All things, as many as the Father hath, are mine; because of this I said, That of mine He will take, and will tell to you;

16.text: a little while, and ye do not behold me, and again a little while, and ye shall see me, because I go away unto the Father.'

19.text: Jesus, therefore, knew that they were wishing to ask him, and he said to them, 'Concerning this do ye seek one with another, because I said, A little while, and you do not behold me, and again a little while, and ye shall see me?

20.text: verily, verily, I say to you, that ye shall weep and lament, and the world will rejoice; and ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow joy will become.

21.text: 'The woman, when she may bear, hath sorrow, because her hour did come, and when she may bear the child, no more doth she remember the anguish, because of the joy that a man was born to the world.

22.text: 'And ye, therefore, now, indeed, have sorrow; and again I will see you, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no one doth take from you,

23.text: and in that day ye will question me nothing; verily, verily, I say to you, as many things as ye may ask of the Father in my name, He will give you;

24.text: till now ye did ask nothing in my name; ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.

25.text: 'These things in similitudes I have spoken to you, but there cometh an hour when no more in similitudes will I speak to you, but freely of the Father, will tell you.

26.text: 'In that day, in my name ye will make request, and I do not say to you that I will ask the Father for you,

27.text: for the Father himself doth love you, because me ye have loved, and ye have believed that I from God came forth;

28.text: I came forth from the Father, and have come to the world; again I leave the world, and go on unto the Father.'

31.text: Jesus answered them, 'Now do ye believe? lo, there doth come an hour,

32.text: and now it hath come, that ye may be scattered, each to his own things, and me ye may leave alone, and I am not alone, because the Father is with me;

33.text: these things I have spoken to you, that in me ye may have peace, in the world ye shall have tribulation, but take courage — I have overcome the world.'

1.text: These things spake Jesus, and lifted up his eyes to the heaven, and said — 'Father, the hour hath come, glorify Thy Son, that Thy Son also may glorify Thee,

2.text: according as Thou didst give to him authority over all flesh, that — all that Thou hast given to him — he may give to them life age-during;

3.text: and this is the life age-during, that they may know Thee, the only true God, and him whom Thou didst send — Jesus Christ;

4.text: I did glorify Thee on the earth, the work I did finish that Thou hast given me, that I may do [it].

5.text: 'And now, glorify me, Thou Father, with Thyself, with the glory that I had before the world was, with Thee;

6.text: I did manifest Thy name to the men whom Thou hast given to me out of the world; Thine they were, and to me Thou hast given them, and Thy word they have kept;

7.text: now they have known that all things, as many as Thou hast given to me, are from Thee,

8.text: because the sayings that Thou hast given to me, I have given to them, and they themselves received, and have known truly, that from Thee I came forth, and they did believe that Thou didst send me.

9.text: 'I ask in regard to them; not in regard to the world do I ask, but in regard to those whom Thou hast given to me, because Thine they are,

10.text: and all mine are Thine, and Thine [are] mine, and I have been glorified in them;

11.text: and no more am I in the world, and these are in the world, and I come unto Thee. Holy Father, keep them in Thy name, whom Thou hast given to me, that they may be one as we;

12.text: when I was with them in the world, I was keeping them in Thy name; those whom Thou hast given to me I did guard, and none of them was destroyed, except the son of the destruction, that the Writing may be fulfilled.

13.text: 'And now unto Thee I come, and these things I speak in the world, that they may have my joy fulfilled in themselves;

14.text: I have given to them Thy word, and the world did hate them, because they are not of the world, as I am not of the world;

15.text: I do not ask that Thou mayest take them out of the world, but that Thou mayest keep them out of the evil.

16.text: 'Of the world they are not, as I of the world am not;

17.text: sanctify them in Thy truth, Thy word is truth;

18.text: as Thou didst send me to the world, I also did send them to the world;

19.text: and for them do I sanctify myself, that they also themselves may be sanctified in truth.

20.text: 'And not in regard to these alone do I ask, but also in regard to those who shall be believing, through their word, in me;

21.text: that they all may be one, as Thou Father [art] in me, and I in Thee; that they also in us may be one, that the world may believe that Thou didst send me.

22.text: 'And I, the glory that thou hast given to me, have given to them, that they may be one as we are one;

23.text: I in them, and Thou in me, that they may be perfected into one, and that the world may know that Thou didst send me, and didst love them as Thou didst love me.

24.text: 'Father, those whom Thou hast given to me, I will that where I am they also may be with me, that they may behold my glory that Thou didst give to me, because Thou didst love me before the foundation of the world.

25.text: 'Righteous Father, also the world did not know Thee, and I knew Thee, and these have known that Thou didst send me,

26.text: and I made known to them Thy name, and will make known, that the love with which Thou lovedst me in them may be, and I in them.'

4.text: Jesus, therefore, knowing all things that are coming upon him, having gone forth, said to them, 'Whom do ye seek?'

5.text: they answered him, 'Jesus the Nazarene;' Jesus saith to them, 'I am [he];' — and Judas who delivered him up was standing with them; —

6.text: when, therefore, he said to them — 'I am [he],' they went away backward, and fell to the ground.

7.text: Again, therefore, he questioned them, 'Whom do ye seek?' and they said, 'Jesus the Nazarene;'

8.text: Jesus answered, 'I said to you that I am [he]; if, then, me ye seek, suffer these to go away;'

11.text: Jesus, therefore, said to Peter, 'Put the sword into the sheath; the cup that the Father hath given to me, may I not drink it?'

20.text: Jesus answered him, 'I spake freely to the world, I did always teach in a synagogue, and in the temple, where the Jews do always come together; and in secret I spake nothing;

21.text: why me dost thou question? question those having heard what I spake to them; lo, these have known what I said.'

23.text: Jesus answered him, 'If I spake ill, testify concerning the ill; and if well, why me dost thou smite?'

34.text: Jesus answered him, 'From thyself dost thou say this? or did others say it to thee about me?'

36.text: Jesus answered, 'My kingdom is not of this world; if my kingdom were of this world, my officers had struggled that I might not be delivered up to Jews; but now my kingdom is not from hence.'

37.text: Pilate, therefore, said to him, 'Art thou then a king?' Jesus answered, 'Thou dost say [it]; because a king I am, I for this have been born, and for this I have come to the world, that I may testify to the truth; every one who is of the truth, doth hear my voice.'

11.text: Jesus answered, 'Thou wouldest have no authority against me, if it were not having been given thee from above; because of this, he who is delivering me up to thee hath greater sin.'

26.text: Jesus, therefore, having seen [his] mother, and the disciple standing by, whom he was loving, he saith to his mother, 'Woman, lo, thy son;'

27.text: afterward he saith to the disciple, 'Lo, thy mother;' and from that hour the disciple took her to his own [home].

28.text: After this, Jesus knowing that all things now have been finished, that the Writing may be fulfilled, saith, 'I thirst;'

30.text: when, therefore, Jesus received the vinegar, he said, 'It hath been finished;' and having bowed the head, gave up the spirit.

15.text: Jesus saith to her, 'Woman, why dost thou weep? whom dost thou seek;' she, supposing that he is the gardener, saith to him, 'Sir, if thou didst carry him away, tell me where thou didst lay him, and I will take him away;'

16.text: Jesus saith to her, 'Mary!' having turned, she saith to him, 'Rabbouni;' that is to say, 'Teacher.'

17.text: Jesus saith to her, 'Be not touching me, for I have not yet ascended unto my Father; and be going on to my brethren, and say to them, I ascend unto my Father, and your Father, and to my God, and to your God.'

19.text: It being, therefore, evening, on that day, the first of the sabbaths, and the doors having been shut where the disciples were assembled, through fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the midst, and saith to them, 'Peace to you;'

21.text: Jesus, therefore, said to them again, 'Peace to you; according as the Father hath sent me, I also send you;'

22.text: and this having said, he breathed on [them], and saith to them, 'Receive the Holy Spirit;

23.text: if of any ye may loose the sins, they are loosed to them; if of any ye may retain, they have been retained.'

26.text: And after eight days, again were his disciples within, and Thomas with them; Jesus cometh, the doors having been shut, and he stood in the midst, and said, 'Peace to you!'

27.text: then he saith to Thomas, 'Bring thy finger hither, and see my hands, and bring thy hand, and put [it] to my side, and become not unbelieving, but believing.'

29.text: Jesus saith to him, 'Because thou hast seen me, Thomas, thou hast believed; happy those not having seen, and having believed.'

5.text: Jesus, therefore, saith to them, 'Lads, have ye any meat?'

6.text: they answered him, 'No;' and he said to them, 'Cast the net at the right side of the boat, and ye shall find;' they cast, therefore, and no longer were they able to draw it, from the multitude of the fishes.

10.text: Jesus saith to them, 'Bring ye from the fishes that ye caught now;'

12.text: Jesus saith to them, 'Come ye, dine;' and none of the disciples was venturing to inquire of him, 'Who art thou?' knowing that it is the Lord;

15.text: When, therefore, they dined, Jesus saith to Simon Peter, 'Simon, [son] of Jonas, dost thou love me more than these?' he saith to him, 'Yes, Lord; thou hast known that I dearly love thee;' he saith to him, 'Feed my lambs.'

16.text: He saith to him again, a second time, 'Simon, [son] of Jonas, dost thou love me?' he saith to him, 'Yes, Lord; thou hast known that I dearly love thee;' he saith to him, 'Tend my sheep.'

17.text: He saith to him the third time, 'Simon, [son] of Jonas, dost thou dearly love me?' Peter was grieved that he said to him the third time, 'Dost thou dearly love me?' and he said to him, 'Lord, thou hast known all things; thou dost know that I dearly love thee.' Jesus saith to him, 'Feed my sheep;

18.text: verily, verily, I say to thee, When thou wast younger, thou wast girding thyself and wast walking whither thou didst will, but when thou mayest be old, thou shalt stretch forth thy hands, and another will gird thee, and shall carry [thee] whither thou dost not will;'

19.text: and this he said, signifying by what death he shall glorify God; and having said this, he saith to him, 'Be following me.'

22.text: Jesus saith to him, 'If him I will to remain till I come, what — to thee? be thou following me.' This word, therefore, went forth to the brethren that that disciple doth not die,
